reading: The Bank of England is expected to increase its benchmark rate on Thursday, potentially marking its first rise in more than three years.
Most analysts anticipate a move from 3.75% to 4%, which would make borrowing more expensive while potentially benefiting savers.
The rate has declined from its 2023–24 peak of 5.25%, but policymakers have held it steady for six consecutive meetings.
Analysts suggest that inflationary pressure, stemming primarily from petrol and diesel prices, will prompt the increase.
One assessment quoted in the report highlights a trade-off between persistently high inflation and sharply weaker growth prospects.
The Consumer Prices Index measure of inflation remains well below its earlier peak, although it has begun rising again and is expected to climb further.
The reported figure for the year to September 2026 was 3.5%, compared with 3.1% a month earlier and the central bank's 2% target.
The effects of the Iran war are filtering through to UK inflation, principally via energy and fuel costs.
Were the Bank rate to increase, the 510,000 tracker mortgage-holders would be affected immediately.
UK Finance calculates that a quarter-percentage-point increase would add £31 to monthly payments on a typical tracker mortgage.
For the 470,000 borrowers on variable mortgage deals, any change in payments would be contingent on their lender's response.
Some borrowers are insulated from an immediate change in monthly payments, although lenders have already priced in the expected increase when offering new deals.
Rachel Springall of Moneyfacts cautions that borrowers' choice ultimately depends on whether they can stomach further rate increases.
The committee's indications of the future course of interest rates will also be closely scrutinised.

vocabulary.definition: A central interest rate that serves as a reference for other lending and savings rates.
Conditions or forces that contribute to increases in the general level of prices.
A situation in which pursuing one desirable outcome involves accepting a disadvantage elsewhere.
The expected chances and extent of future economic expansion.
Gradually reaching another part of a system and producing effects there.
Dependent on a particular condition, event or decision.

vocabulary.part_of_speech: past participle used as an adjective
vocabulary.definition: Protected from a particular effect, without necessarily being protected from every related consequence.
Already taken into account when setting a price or interest rate, before the anticipated event occurs.
To tolerate something difficult or unpleasant; here, to accept the financial burden of further increases.
Examined closely and critically, especially to identify details with wider significance.

entries.ja: ほかの貸出金利や預金金利の基準となる中心的な金利。
entries.ko: 다른 대출 금리와 저축 금리의 기준이 되는 중심 금리.
entries.zh-Hans: 作为其他贷款利率和储蓄利率参考标准的主要利率。
entries.es: Un tipo de interés principal que sirve de referencia para otros tipos de interés de préstamos y ahorros.
entries.pt-BR: Uma taxa de juros principal que serve de referência para outras taxas de juros de empréstimos e de poupança.
entries.fr: Un taux d’intérêt principal qui sert de référence aux autres taux appliqués aux prêts et à l’épargne.
entries.de: Ein zentraler Zinssatz, der als Orientierung für andere Kredit- und Sparzinsen dient.

entries.ja: 物価全体の上昇につながる状況や力。
entries.ko: 전반적인 물가 수준의 상승에 영향을 주는 여건이나 힘.
entries.zh-Hans: 推动整体物价水平上涨的条件或力量。
entries.es: Condiciones o fuerzas que contribuyen al aumento del nivel general de los precios.
entries.pt-BR: Condições ou forças que contribuem para o aumento do nível geral dos preços.
entries.fr: Des conditions ou des forces qui contribuent à la hausse du niveau général des prix.
entries.de: Bedingungen oder Kräfte, die zu einem Anstieg des allgemeinen Preisniveaus beitragen.

entries.ja: 望ましい結果を一つ追求するために、別の面で不利益を受け入れなければならない状況。
entries.ko: 바람직한 결과 하나를 추구하려면 다른 측면에서 불리한 점을 받아들여야 하는 상황.
entries.zh-Hans: 追求某个理想结果时，必须接受其他方面的不利之处的情况。
entries.es: Una situación en la que buscar un resultado deseable implica aceptar una desventaja en otro aspecto.
entries.pt-BR: Uma situação em que buscar um resultado desejável implica aceitar uma desvantagem em outro aspecto.
entries.fr: Une situation dans laquelle la recherche d’un résultat souhaitable implique d’accepter un désavantage sur un autre plan.
entries.de: Eine Situation, in der das Streben nach einem erwünschten Ergebnis bedeutet, an anderer Stelle einen Nachteil in Kauf zu nehmen.

entries.ja: 今後、経済が拡大する可能性と、その拡大の程度についての見通し。
entries.ko: 앞으로 경제가 성장할 가능성과 성장 규모에 대한 전망.
entries.zh-Hans: 对未来经济扩张的可能性及程度的预期。
entries.es: Las posibilidades previstas de que la economía crezca en el futuro y la magnitud esperada de ese crecimiento.
entries.pt-BR: As chances previstas de a economia crescer no futuro e a dimensão esperada desse crescimento.
entries.fr: Les prévisions concernant la probabilité d’une expansion économique future et l’ampleur de cette expansion.
entries.de: Die erwarteten Chancen auf künftiges Wirtschaftswachstum und dessen voraussichtliches Ausmaß.

entries.ja: 仕組みの別の部分に徐々に伝わり、そこで影響を及ぼしていること。
entries.ko: 한 체계의 다른 부분에 점차 전달되어 그곳에 영향을 미치고 있는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 正在逐渐传导到一个系统的其他部分，并在那里产生影响。
entries.es: Llegar gradualmente a otra parte de un sistema y producir efectos allí.
entries.pt-BR: Chegar gradualmente a outra parte de um sistema e produzir efeitos ali.
entries.fr: Se transmettre progressivement à une autre partie d’un système et y produire des effets.
entries.de: Allmählich in einen anderen Teil eines Systems gelangen und dort Auswirkungen haben.

entries.ja: 特定の条件、出来事、または決定によって左右されること。
entries.ko: 특정 조건이나 사건 또는 결정에 달려 있는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 取决于某个特定条件、事件或决定。
entries.es: Que depende de una condición, un acontecimiento o una decisión en particular.
entries.pt-BR: Que depende de uma condição, de um acontecimento ou de uma decisão específica.
entries.fr: Qui dépend d’une condition, d’un événement ou d’une décision particulière.
entries.de: Von einer bestimmten Bedingung, einem Ereignis oder einer Entscheidung abhängig.

entries.ja: 特定の影響からは守られているが、関連するすべての影響から守られているとは限らない状態。
entries.ko: 특정 영향으로부터 보호되지만, 관련된 모든 결과로부터 반드시 보호되는 것은 아닌 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 受到保护而免于某种特定影响，但不一定能免于所有相关后果。
entries.es: Protegido de un efecto concreto, sin estar necesariamente protegido de todas las consecuencias relacionadas.
entries.pt-BR: Protegido de um efeito específico, sem necessariamente estar protegido de todas as consequências relacionadas.
entries.fr: Protégé d’un effet particulier, sans nécessairement être protégé de toutes les conséquences qui y sont liées.
entries.de: Vor einer bestimmten Auswirkung geschützt, ohne deshalb zwangsläufig vor allen damit verbundenen Folgen geschützt zu sein.

entries.ja: 予想される出来事が起こる前に、価格や金利の設定ですでに考慮され、反映されていること。
entries.ko: 예상되는 일이 일어나기 전에 가격이나 금리를 정할 때 이미 고려되어 반영된 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 在预期事件发生之前，已经在设定价格或利率时加以考虑并反映在其中。
entries.es: Ya tenido en cuenta al fijar un precio o un tipo de interés, antes de que ocurra el acontecimiento previsto.
entries.pt-BR: Já levado em conta na definição de um preço ou de uma taxa de juros, antes de o acontecimento previsto ocorrer.
entries.fr: Déjà pris en compte lors de la fixation d’un prix ou d’un taux d’intérêt, avant que l’événement anticipé ne se produise.
entries.de: Bei der Festlegung eines Preises oder Zinssatzes bereits berücksichtigt, bevor das erwartete Ereignis eintritt.

entries.ja: 困難なことや不快なことに耐えること。ここでは、さらなる金利上昇による経済的な負担を受け入れること。
entries.ko: 어렵거나 불쾌한 일을 견디는 것. 여기서는 추가 금리 인상에 따른 재정적 부담을 감수하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 忍受困难或令人不快的事情；这里指承受利率进一步上升带来的经济负担。
entries.es: Tolerar algo difícil o desagradable; aquí, aceptar la carga económica de nuevas subidas de los tipos de interés.
entries.pt-BR: Tolerar algo difícil ou desagradável; aqui, aceitar o peso financeiro de novos aumentos dos juros.
entries.fr: Supporter quelque chose de difficile ou de désagréable ; ici, accepter la charge financière de nouvelles hausses des taux d’intérêt.
entries.de: Etwas Schwieriges oder Unangenehmes ertragen; hier die finanzielle Belastung durch weitere Zinserhöhungen hinnehmen.

entries.ja: 特に、より広い意味を持つ細かな点を見つけるために、注意深く批判的に調べられたこと。
entries.ko: 특히 더 폭넓은 의미를 지닌 세부 사항을 찾아내기 위해 면밀하고 비판적으로 검토된 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 经过仔细、批判性的审查，尤其是为了找出具有更广泛意义的细节。
entries.es: Examinado de forma minuciosa y crítica, especialmente para identificar detalles con un significado más amplio.
entries.pt-BR: Examinado de forma minuciosa e crítica, especialmente para identificar detalhes com um significado mais amplo.
entries.fr: Examiné attentivement et avec un regard critique, notamment pour repérer des détails ayant une portée plus large.
entries.de: Genau und kritisch untersucht, insbesondere um Einzelheiten von weiterreichender Bedeutung zu erkennen.

review.method: separate ChatGPT plan translation and independent editing sessions
